command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual
test "$(hostname)" = "ai-core-node-projekt-frankenstein"
EXPECTED_DAEMON="0ab232f7112b046ced7e3e4ae454fe0d800eebd32d23bdac138c961bc069dff9"
EXPECTED_HTML="87cc0e3a94781f90a7533b129743597753876a8410b868767d243b753c5d3645"
test "$(sha256sum buehne_daemon.py | awk '{print $1}')" = "$EXPECTED_DAEMON"
test "$(sha256sum buehne.html | awk '{print $1}')" = "$EXPECTED_HTML"
test "$(sha256sum buehne_daemon.py.go-gpu-backup-20260912T0708 | awk '{print $1}')" = "$EXPECTED_DAEMON"
echo '=== BEFORE BLOCK ==='
sed -n '1098,1108p' buehne_daemon.py
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('buehne_daemon.py')
s=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
old='''             "--disable-gpu",
             "--disable-gpu-compositing",
             "--disable-software-rasterizer"],'''
new='''],'''
if s.count(old) != 1:
    raise SystemExit(f'exact GPU flag block count={s.count(old)} expected=1')
s2=s.replace(old,new,1)
if '--disable-gpu' in s2 or '--disable-gpu-compositing' in s2 or '--disable-software-rasterizer' in s2:
    raise SystemExit('GPU-disable token remains after exact block replacement')
p.write_text(s2,encoding='utf-8')
PY
python3 -m py_compile buehne_daemon.py
NEW_SHA="$(sha256sum buehne_daemon.py | awk '{print $1}')"
echo "OLD_SHA=$EXPECTED_DAEMON"
echo "NEW_SHA=$NEW_SHA"
echo '=== AFTER BLOCK ==='
sed -n '1098,1106p' buehne_daemon.py
systemctl --user restart frankenstein-buehne.service
sleep 12
test "$(systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-buehne.service)" = "active"
curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8788/ >/dev/null
echo '=== LIVE MAIN CHROME ==='
pgrep -af '/opt/google/chrome/chrome --app=http://127.0.0.1:8788/' || true
if pgrep -af '/opt/google/chrome/chrome --app=http://127.0.0.1:8788/.*--disable-gpu' >/dev/null; then
  echo 'FAIL: disable-gpu still present on live main chrome' >&2
  cp -a buehne_daemon.py.go-gpu-backup-20260912T0708 buehne_daemon.py
  python3 -m py_compile buehne_daemon.py
  systemctl --user restart frankenstein-buehne.service
  exit 41
fi
echo '=== LIVE RENDERER/GPU ==='
ps -eo pid,pcpu,rss,args | grep '/opt/google/chrome/chrome --type=\(renderer\|gpu-process\)' | grep 'chrome-profile' | grep -v grep | head -12 || true
echo '=== FPS SAMPLES ==='
for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do
  date +%H:%M:%S
  curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8788/api/status | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(json.dumps(d.get("fps"),ensure_ascii=False))'
  sleep 3
done
echo '=== FINAL HASHES ==='
sha256sum buehne_daemon.py buehne.html filmlook.js
